title: The corrected category-prefix filter still relied on an incorrect inventory classification: projects/Work法律全场景/README.md
facts: The corrected category-prefix filter still relied on an incorrect inventory classification: projects/Work法律全场景/README.md was categorized as an engineering document although it is protected project/business material. The link checker opened 64 Markdown files and included that protected project README. Its result is withdrawn. No files were written by the checker.
evidence: The allowlist selected all rows whose kind did not start with excluded-, including projects/Work法律全场景/README.md.
The objective excludes project business materials; path-level exclusion was missing.
impact: Second read-boundary violation. Prior link-check result is invalid. Inventory classification alone is insufficient; project scope requires explicit path allowlisting.

updates.action: 为当前 Trace 查看器补齐其要求的记录字段；保留原事实、证据和范围边界。当前只读/修改范围按本轮明确allowlist执行。历史事件本身不撤销。

Use an explicit path allowlist that permits project utility sources/docs only under approved scripts/tool subtrees and explicitly excludes project roots, materials, authoring skills, attachments, prompt templates, frozen inputs, and historical evidence. Stop on any path not affirmatively included.
